standard.source_leg_surfaces: Baked 23% STRIDE-01-derived upper/lower/rod/upright/wheel surfaces; original topology, normals and colours. Geometry stays rigid during animation.
standard.pallet_body: Exact original P-01 master/game surface, with its original 1.2 × 1.0 × 0.16 m envelope and support layout.
standard.fork_access: Miniature mechanisms occupy the original underside pockets; fork entry is not certified.

runtime.engine_pivots: Drive only via the supplied adapter; STRIDE-01 runtime is not compatible with this new hierarchy.
runtime.parking_supports: Four inboard miniature jacks, each with three rigid 50 mm sections; at most 130 mm total extension and at least 6.6 mm overlap.

lod_selection.lod0: Explicit close inspection, animation and recordings.
lod_selection.lod1: Default articulated game asset with all packing pivots.
lod_selection.lod2: One frozen surface per configuration; map/loading only, never animate.

preserved_revision.note: Prior 440 mm concept superseded by exact P-01 dimensions.
